subject: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal

Team —

Quick summary after the vendor check-ins last week: Zendesk enterprise licenses for our primary instance expire on 2027-06-30 (annual roll). Gainsight renewal for CS platform is on 2027-07-15 (contracted SOW-based). Intercom opportunity (pilot) is ready to scale but we need an agreed procurement path and a cutover plan if we consolidate.

I attached a support_tool_inventory.xlsx that lists active seats, integrations, and contract owners. High-level proposal options:
- Option A: Renew Zendesk for 12 months, do incremental Gainsight SOW, postpone Intercom consolidation until Q4.
- Option B: Initiate a phased cutover to Intercom (pilot -> accounts -> full), negotiate early-termination credit with Zendesk, and align Gainsight scope to support health scores and playbooks.

Key asks:
1) Laura — can procurement provide lead times/required artifacts for cancellations or amendments?
2) Marissa — can your team map 2–3 critical integrations that must migrate (Salesforce sync, billing webhooks, KB exports)?
3) Dylan — want you to own the cutover runbook and downtime communication if we go Option B.

Target decision window: firm recommendation by 2027-04-15 so we can hit vendor notice periods.

Attachment: support_tool_inventory.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-team@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement notes: for cancellations that request early-termination credits we need 60 days notice and the last 3 months of billing detail + active seat counts by product SKU. I attached the standard vendor-amendment checklist in the procurement drive (link in related_links).

For renewals, procurement prefers consolidated negotiations (one-point-of-contact) — we can drive combined Zendesk + Gainsight discussion if leadership confirms scope.

I will request the billing extracts from finance and share by 2027-04-05.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Price <michael.price@gainsight.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Collins <sarah@zendesksales.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal

Hi Vivek / Marissa —

Appreciate the heads-up. Attaching a draft SOW that scopes the renewal and a 3-month migration assistance add-on (gainsight_sow_draft.pdf). Our migration team can provide an export/import plan for customer health timelines and playbooks; the typical engagement is 6–8 weeks.

Important note: if Redwood plans to change primary ticketing systems (Zendesk -> Intercom), some Gainsight connectors will need rework — that impacts price and schedule. We can prepare a revised quote once you confirm the ticketing roadmap.

Attachment: gainsight_sow_draft.pdf (pdf, 128 KB)

Best,
Michael Price
Enterprise Sales, Gainsight
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal

Vivek —

I've skimmed the inventory and the SOW. A few quick items from CS:
- Critical integrations: Salesforce case sync (all open + closed history), billing webhooks (for refund workflows), KB article IDs (used in outbound sequences).
- Data retention: Zendesk stores 5 years of ticket history; we need a plan to archive or make searchable post-cutover.
- Migration windows: prefer low-activity weekend (Sat 02:00–06:00 PT) for schema changes; live cutover should be staged by customer cohort to avoid bulk failover.

Question for procurement: what vendor-mandated notice do we need to request refund/credit? Laura — looks like 60 days, but confirm if we can scope a partial-credit approach.

Also, can we get a short technical assessment from Intercom (Raj) on available import tooling and limits (attachments, macros, chat transcripts)? Raj — if you can provide a one-page capability summary that'd help the decision.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Price <michael.price@gainsight.com>, Sarah Collins <sarah@zendesksales.com>, Raj Patel <raj@intercom-partner.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support stack sunset & cutover planning (Zendesk -> Intercom) + Gainsight renewal

Team — quick sync and agreed next steps below. I'll put these in a shared doc and open the procurement ticket today.

Agreed high-level timeline (target if we select Option B):
- 2027-04-05: Procurement compiles billing extracts and vendor amendment checklist (LAURA)
- 2027-04-09: Intercom capability one-pager from Raj (RAJ) and updated Gainsight quote for connector changes (MICHAEL)
- 2027-04-12: Leadership recommendation (Vivek/Marissa) + sign-off to proceed with negotiations
- 2027-06-24 to 2027-06-27: Planned phased cutover weekend (cohort A -> cohort B) if notice/credits negotiated

Action owners:
- Laura: procurement artifacts & vendor notice path (due 2027-04-05)
- Marissa: integration inventory + migration acceptance criteria (due 2027-04-07)
- Dylan: cutover runbook draft + comms plan (due 2027-04-10)

Procurement link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/PROC-4729
Doc for sign-off: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-cutover-plan
DocuSign template (procurement): https://www.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-PROC-2027

Attachments referenced: zendesk_contract_summary.pdf (pdf, 55 KB) — Laura, please add the billing extract when available.

Short replies welcome — otherwise I'll assume owners accept and will proceed to open vendor negotiations on Monday.

Thanks all,
Vivek
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
